key_points: Shopify has signed a deal to make eligible stores fully shoppable via Meta's new AI shopping agent Muse.
Amazon has blocked Muse from its platform, contrasting with Shopify's openness and giving Shopify a potential edge in AI‑driven commerce.
PayPal (and reportedly Stripe) are powering Meta's Muse, adding payment‑processing credibility to the Shopify‑Muse integration.
Amazon's announcement of expanded multichannel tools for sellers is largely generic and poses only modest competitive pressure.
The combined effect suggests a modest near‑term upside for Shopify as its ecosystem gains AI‑enabled sales channels.
